note: Pottawatomie County OK (40125) publishes no queryable parcel service or file. County GIS and assessor pages link no REST service. Statewide OGI Statewide_Parcels is WMS view-only, 'not available for download'. Commercial vendors (Acres, Dynamo, Rockford) only. The ptcounty.maps.arcgis.com web map and its ParcelsAll/CoparcelO services belong to Pottawatomie County, Kansas, not Oklahoma; www2.pottcounty.org is also Kansas. ArcGIS Online and Hub searches found no Oklahoma Pottawatomie parcel layer.
